app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:47 — The add/remove mutation promises detach the follow-up refresh, so callers report success before the UI reload finishes and refresh failures become unhandled.
records.rationale: In discourse/models/group.js, both removeMember and addMembers return Discourse.ajax(...).then(function() { self.findMembers(); }); but the callback does not return the findMembers() promise. That means the returned promise resolves as soon as the add/remove request completes, before the members refresh finishes, and any findMembers() failure would not be chained/handled by the caller.
